title: 第007章 两红一金第008章 阶位豁免
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业看着面前没什么变化的堕天圣堂，直接查看了一下最新属性。
姓名：堕天圣堂
等级：2
阶位：神级
阵营：混乱阵营
消耗：1金币（100w）
升级：本源结晶x1000，金币x1w，黑暗之种x1
“本源结晶要一千，金币要1w了，还需要特殊材料，这才2级到3级啊。”苏业咂舌看着堕天圣堂的属性。
每日上限也只是提升到20而已，一万单位为一个军团，这需要多久才能招募到一个军团？
高阶领主之间的战役，基本上都是几十万为一个单位的投入进去。
不过这也是没办法的事情，兵种的阶位越高，兵营等级一样，但是招募的数量也是不一样的。
“20就20吧，20有20的打法。”苏业看着面前的堕天圣堂直接走了进去，莉莉丝跟在苏业的身后。
【叮：是否招募兵种？】
“招募。”苏业看向面前的堕天使雕像。
【叮：消耗10金币，招募成功！】
无数的黑红色的雾气在大殿之中弥漫，莉莉丝眼中带着一丝无趣的神色看向那涌动的黑红色雾气。
十道身影浮现在了黑红色的雾气之中，高挑的身材，凹凸有致。
当黑红色的雾气散去，十道身影半跪在地上，眸子之中带着无比狂热的原罪堕天使齐声说道：“吾等，参见神皇大人！”
“起来吧。”苏业看着十位原罪堕天使，眼中带着喜色。
虽然自己现在只有二十单位的兵种，但是每一个兵种都是神级兵种单位，成长上限可是摆在那里的。
刚刚招募出来的十单位兵种，也都是属于原罪堕天使序列的存在，属于异种堕天使。
大概是因为苏业麾下现在就莉莉丝这一位英雄单位，莉莉丝是原罪堕天使序列的英雄单位，所以招募出来的都是原罪堕天使。
没有其祂堕天使序列英雄单位出现，大概率是招募不出来其祂序列的堕天使单位。
这次没有招募出英雄单位，也很正常，毕竟英雄单位不是那么好招募的。
“莉莉丝，她们交给你了。”苏业向着莉莉丝说道。
“好的神皇大人。”莉莉丝笑着看向刚刚招募出来的十单位英雄兵种。
“你先带她们去和其她会合吧。”苏业向着莉莉丝说道。
莉莉丝点了点头，随后看向刚刚招募出来的十位原罪堕天使：“你们跟妾身走吧。”
十位原罪堕天使看了一眼苏业，随后跟着莉莉丝离开。
苏业看着带着原罪堕天使离开的莉莉丝，直接盘坐在大殿之中，打开了领主之心。
【叮：是否消耗100本源结晶，升级领主之心？】
“升级！”苏业带着期待的说道。
【叮：你的领主之心等提升目前等级：黑铁2星，可选择新词条！】
一股暖流从手腕上流动了起来，不断的游走苏业的全身，开始强化苏业的身体。
content_en:
Su ye looked at the Fallen Heaven Temple, which had not changed much in front of him, and directly checked the latest attributes.
Name: Fallen Temple
Level: 2
Rank: God level
Faction: Chaos Faction
Recruitment: 1020 (daily)
Consumption: 1 gold coin (100w)
Upgrade: Origin Crystal x1000, Gold Coin x1w, Dark Seed x1
...........
"The origin crystal costs one thousand, the gold coin costs 10,000, and special materials are needed. This is only level 2 to level 3." Su Ye clicked his tongue and looked at the attributes of the Fallen Heaven Temple.
The daily upper limit has only been increased to 20. Ten thousand units constitute a legion. How long does it take to recruit a legion?
In battles between high-ranking lords, hundreds of thousands of people are basically invested per unit.
However, there is nothing that can be done about it. The higher the rank of the soldier, the level of the barracks is the same, but the number of recruits is also different.
"20 is 20, there is a way to play 20." Su ye looked at the Fallen Heaven Temple in front of him and walked in directly, with Lilith following behind Su ye.
[Ding: Do you want to recruit troops? 】
"Recruiting." Su ye looked at the fallen angel statue in front of him.
[Ding: Spend 10 gold coins and the recruitment is successful! 】
Countless black and red mist filled the hall, and Lilith looked at the surging black and red mist with a bored look in her eyes.
Ten figures emerged in the black-red mist, with tall and slender figures.
When the black-red mist dissipated, ten figures were half-kneeling on the ground, and the original sin fallen angels with extremely fanatical eyes said in unison: "We, meet the God Emperor!"
"Get up." Su Ye looked at the ten original sin fallen angels with joy in his eyes.
Although I only have twenty units of arms now, each of them is a god-level unit, and the upper limit of growth is there.
The ten units of troops that have just been recruited are all of the original sin fallen angel sequence, and they are alien fallen angels.
Probably because Su Ye currently has Lilith, a heroic unit under his command. Lilith is a heroic unit of the Original Sin Fallen Angel sequence, so all those recruited are Original Sin Fallen Angels.
No other fallen angel sequence hero units appear, and there is a high probability that other fallen angel sequence units cannot be recruited.
It is normal that no hero units were recruited this time. After all, hero units are not so easy to recruit.
"Lilith, I leave them to you." Su ye said to Lilith.
"Okay, Lord God Emperor." Lilith smiled and looked at the ten units of hero soldiers she had just recruited.
"Take them to meet the others first." Su ye said to Lilith.
Lilith nodded, and then looked at the ten original sin fallen angels she had just recruited: "You guys can go with me."
The ten original sin fallen angels glanced at Su ye, and then followed Lilith away.
Su Ye watched Lilith leaving with the Original Sin Fallen Angel, sitting cross-legged in the hall, and opened the Lord's Heart.
[Ding: Do you want to consume 100 source crystals to upgrade the Lord’s Heart? 】
"Upgrade!" Su ye said expectantly.
[Ding: Your Lord’s Heart has been upgraded to its current level: Black Iron 2 stars, and you can choose new entries! 】
A warm current began to flow from his wrist and continued to travel throughout Su ye's body, beginning to strengthen Su ye's body.
